thread:
lila_sales: Quick heads-up: ClearWave Bank needs a compliance drop for our POC. They asked for SOC 2 snapshot, ISO scope summary, a signed pen-test attestation, logical network diagram (no internal IPs), and a short KMS separation note. They want a zip or link they can download. Deadline: next Friday. Any blockers?
kevin_se: Is this for Hosted or Dedicated? That affects pen-test wording and what we can disclose.
lila_sales: Hosted API POC only. They said Dedicated might come later.
nora_security: We can provide: redacted SOC 2 Type II summary, ISO 27001 scope statement, sanitized logical diagram, KMS/keyflow note, and a Redwood-signed attestation about pen-test engagement/remediation. We cannot share raw vuln logs, internal tickets, or private keys.
sam_legal: Confirmed. Legal can sign a Redwood attestation PDF that states we engaged a third-party test on DATE and remediated critical issues. We will also give a vendor-agnostic pen-test letter template for their legal to use if they need vendor signature.
mike_eng: I will assemble the logical diagram and KMS note. I can create a presigned S3 URL for the bundle (7-day expiry). ETA: diagram + KMS doc in ~24h.
deploy-bot: presigned_url_created: https://s3.amazonaws.com/compliance-redwood/clearwave-poc/evidence_bundle.zip?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Expires=604800
kevin_se: For uploads, recommend manifest.txt with sha256 checksums and request origin IP range if they want extra assurance. We should restrict the presigned URL to one object and TLS.
lila_sales: Customer asked for chain-of-custody confirmation. Can we verify manifest and then sign receipt?
nora_security: Yes. Have them upload clearwave_customer_artifacts.zip containing manifest.txt. Our SOC team will verify checksums and issue a signed receiving attestation PDF listing files and checksums.
sam_legal: We can e-sign via DocuSign. If customer redlines vendor pen-test template, route to me.
mike_eng: Upload instructions to paste to customer:
1) Download evidence_bundle.zip (readme) from the URL.
2) Put your artifacts into clearwave_customer_artifacts.zip and include manifest.txt at top-level with sha256 checksums. Example manifest lines: `1f2d3e4...  config.yml`
3) PUT to presigned URL: `curl -X PUT -T clearwave_customer_artifacts.zip "<presigned_url>"`
Note: link expires in 7 days.
kevin_se: Ill also add a manifest template and recommend filename patterns to avoid PII.
lila_sales: Thanks — Ill message the bank with the list and timeline. Nora/Sam, can you aim to have the attestation + pen-test template by EOD tomorrow so I can show legal/compliance today?
nora_security: Will do. Sam?
sam_legal: Yes, will draft attestation + pen-test template and share by EOD tomorrow.
lila_sales: Awesome, appreciate it. Ill update thread with any customer asks (vendor-signed report request, additional scoping).
